sentences.en: There is no aspect of relaxation more important than breathing.
sentences.zh: 1. 没有比呼吸更重要的放松方式了。

sentences.en: When dreams begin, breathing becomes irregular and less deep.
sentences.zh: 2. 当梦想开始时，呼吸变得不规则且变浅。

sentences.en: He was breathing with difficulty, but he was conscious.
sentences.zh: 3. 他呼吸困难，但意识清醒。
